strings.Built-in extraction for RAR, ZIP, 7z, TA:
Built-in extraction for RAR, ZIP, 7z, TAR, ISO and more.
Drop files or folders to create RAR5, ZIP or 7z.
strings.Passwords use standard input, never comm: Passwords use standard input, never command arguments or settings. Encrypted task logs appear after completion. Creates new RAR5 archives without overwriting existing archives.
strings.7-Zip is included for browsing, extracti: 7-Zip is included for browsing, extraction and testing. RAR creation and recovery require a separately licensed RARLAB tool.
strings.Open an archive, or drop files to create: Open an archive, or drop files to create one
strings.Duplicate paths prevent reliable item se: Duplicate paths prevent reliable item selection.
strings.This archive contains unsafe paths or li: This archive contains unsafe paths or links. Extraction was refused; inspect it with a trusted tool.
strings.Add a 3% recovery record to the original: Add a 3% recovery record to the original archive?
strings.Create 10% recovery volumes beside the a: Create 10% recovery volumes beside the archive?
strings.Recovery records modify the original RAR: Recovery records modify the original RAR. Recovery volumes require a multi-volume RAR. Keep a backup.
strings.Volumes with this name already exist. Ch: Volumes with this name already exist. Choose another name.
strings.Cancelled. Partial output may remain; ch: Cancelled. Partial output may remain; check the destination.
strings.Engine exit code {0}. Check stderr/stdou: Engine exit code {0}. Check stderr/stdout. If the password is wrong, enter it and reload.
strings.Passwords cannot contain newlines or NUL: Passwords cannot contain newlines or NUL and must not exceed 127 Unicode code points.
strings.This item contains wildcard characters o: This item contains wildcard characters or an unsafe path and cannot be safely extracted by selection.
strings.Select files; volume size must be 0–1000: Select files; volume size must be 0–1000000 MB and recovery record 0–100%.
strings.Choose a new .rar filename that does not: Choose a new .rar filename that does not already exist.
strings.Source names contain unsupported newline: Source names contain unsupported newlines or wildcards.
strings.Source items must share one parent folde: Source items must share one parent folder. You may select their common parent folder instead.
strings.The output archive cannot be inside a se: The output archive cannot be inside a selected source folder.
strings.The engine path must be an absolute path: The engine path must be an absolute path to an executable: {0}
strings.Choose macOS ARM (Apple Silicon) or x64: Choose macOS ARM (Apple Silicon) or x64 (Intel) on the download page. Unpack it, then select the rar executable above.
strings.RAR creation and recovery require the RA: RAR creation and recovery require the RARLAB tool. Download it from the official website, unpack it, and select rar in Settings.
strings.Language packs contain text only; missin: Language packs contain text only; missing entries fall back to English. System dialogs and raw CLI logs may use the system or tool language.
strings.History cleared. Original files were not: History cleared. Original files were not deleted.
strings.Opening nested archives is not supported: Opening nested archives is not supported yet.
This file cannot be opened safely.
strings.This type cannot be opened directly. Ext: This type cannot be opened directly. Extract it first and inspect it yourself.
strings.Only regular files in safe, link-free ar: Only regular files in safe, link-free archives can be opened, up to 512 MB per file.
strings.The system default app will open this co: The system default app will open this copy. Open only trusted files. Edits are not saved back to the archive; temporary copies are removed when ArchiveDesk quits.
No default app could open this file.
strings.Opened a temporary copy. Changes will no: Opened a temporary copy. Changes will not be saved to the archive.
strings.The archive was created, but its test fa: The archive was created, but its test failed or was cancelled. Check the log.
strings.Profile saved (without passwords, source: Profile saved (without passwords, source paths, volume size or recovery ratio).
strings.Passwords stay in memory. Creates new ar: Passwords stay in memory. Creates new archives only; never replaces archives or deletes source files.
strings.Examples: *.tmp or *.DS_Store. Supports: Examples: *.tmp or *.DS_Store. Supports * and ?. No absolute paths, .. or @ list files.
strings.Solid mode can improve compression of si: Solid mode can improve compression of similar files, but single-file extraction may be slower. Volumes use a new separate folder.
strings.ZIP uses AES-256 but cannot encrypt file: ZIP uses AES-256 but cannot encrypt filenames; some system extractors do not support it. RAR5 / 7z support filename encryption.
strings.On macOS, ctime means status-change time: On macOS, ctime means status-change time, not creation time. The Windows creation-time switch is omitted. ZIP / 7z use engine defaults.
strings.Invalid options. Use one exclude pattern: Invalid options. Use one exclude pattern per line, without absolute paths, .. or @ list files.
strings.Choose a new filename with the correct e: Choose a new filename with the correct extension for the selected format.
strings.Based on the loaded listing, not a compl: Based on the loaded listing, not a complete format-property inspection.
